description: Public Bicycle Parking is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. The CPA is offering monthly bicycle parking at most of its parkades. Our secured bicycle parking locations are equipped with a bicycle repair stand and tools that customers can use for free. Bicycle tire need inflating? You can use one of our free tire inflation stations located in most parkades. Find out more at: and. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are bike, bicycle, parking. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: The City of Calgary. The portal shows 2018-02-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
